import fnmatch, glob
from pathlib import Path
from gov.launch import criticality as crit
from gov.guard.decide import _load_ticket
g = "fixtures/evaluation/*/hidden/*"
for p in ["fixtures/evaluation/examin/**", "fixtures/evaluation/examin/*", "fixtures/evaluation/examin/",
          "fixtures/evaluation/**", "fixtures/**", "fixtures/evaluation/examin/hidden/**",
          "fixtures/evaluation/examin/hidden", "fixtures/evaluation/*/hidden/**"]:
    print(f"{p:45s} fwd={fnmatch.fnmatchcase(p, g)!s:5s} rev={fnmatch.fnmatchcase(g, p)!s:5s} "
          f"class={crit.ticket_criticality(Path('.'), {'profile': 'STANDARD', 'allowed_paths': [p]})}"
          f" with-probe={crit.ticket_criticality(Path('.'), {'profile': 'STANDARD', 'allowed_paths': [p, 'docs/probes/X/**  # rec']})}")
print("--- real tickets naming fixtures/evaluation/:")
for f in sorted(glob.glob('.tickets/*.md')):
    t = _load_ticket('.', Path(f).stem)
    ap = [a for a in t.get('allowed_paths', []) if 'fixtures/evaluation' in a]
    if ap:
        print(Path(f).stem, t.get('wbs_id'), t.get('status'), t.get('profile'), crit.ticket_criticality(Path('.'), t), ap)
EOF
